result.response:
I am running the test suite and analyzing the proxy authentication handling in `requests/utils.py`.
I have resolved the proxy authentication issue in [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-842xed9g/requests/utils.py#L960-L986) in [requests/utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-842xed9g/requests/utils.py).

### Cause
`prepend_scheme_if_needed` uses `urllib3.util.parse_url` and retrieves `parsed.netloc` when reconstructing the URL via `urlunparse`. Unlike `urllib.parse.urlparse`, `urllib3`'s `Url.netloc` property only includes `host` and `port` and omits `auth`, stripping proxy credentials before [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_headers`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-842xed9g/requests/adapters.py#L373-L393) extracts them.

### Solution
Re-attach the `auth` component to `netloc` (`'@'.join([auth, netloc])`) when `auth` is present in [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-842xed9g/requests/utils.py#L977-L980).
